messages:
maria: FYI nightly kernel scan (arch-sensitive probe) flagged a perf regression on Ampere for seqlen=2048, kernel=matmul_fused_v3. CI summary below.
kevin: how large is the regression?
maria: about ~12% p99 latency increase on single-stream microbench (batch=1). throughput ~8% drop.
sasha: which commit introduced v3 into autotune?
ci-bot: nightly-scan 2026-03-16 03:12UTC - run: https://ci.redwood/internal/arch-scan/1812504321 (logs + artifacts) :information_source:
ryan: preliminary hypothesis: auto-selector picked an int8-tuned path for Ampere that falls back to a slower layout for long seqlens. misses fused-epilogue kernel.
maria: attached a quick flamegraph from perf (see artifact). snippet: 
```
# perf top excerpt
matmul_fused_v3::kernel_entry 34.2%
gemm_tile13 18.7%
memcpy 12.4%
```
kevin: also observed increased KV-cache evictions in a multi-session run when crossing 1024 tokens, eviction rate jumped x3.
sasha: can we reproduce locally with the harness? try: `./bench --arch ampere --seqlen 2048 --repeat 50 --kv --batch 1`
maria: starting that now. will also run with `--force-kernel=matmul_fused_v2` for A/B.
bench-bot: local-harness run queued (id: 1812504390). artifact: s3://redwood-ci/bench/1812504390/results.json
bench-bot: results: v2 (forced): p99=41.8ms; v3: p99=46.8ms -> regression reproduced. avg throughput v2=120 tok/s, v3=111 tok/s. :exclamation:
ryan: ok, actionable: remove matmul_fused_v3 from Ampere auto-picks for seqlen>=1536 until we root cause. add microprobe that exercises tile13 with long KV contexts.
kevin: I'll draft a tiny perf-ci test that pins arch=ampere, seeds workload with varying seqlens [512,1024,1536,2048], asserts p99 within 5% of baseline.
sasha: also add counters to nightly-scan: kv_hit_ratio, kv_read_lat_ms, kernel_fallback_count. want these in the dashboard to spot regressions earlier.
maria: noticed batching heuristics exacerbated tail when continuous-batching waited to fill batches at long seqlens -> added metric: batch_assembly_delay_ms.
ryan: good. also we should snapshot compiler flags used by the kernel selector in the bench artifacts so autotuner repros are deterministic (quantized vs fp16 layouts).
kevin: opening PR: runtime: exclude matmul_fused_v3 for Ampere seqlen>=1536 + add perf-ci test (WIP). link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/724
maria: thanks. once PR lands, let's run full nightly-scan sweep again. after that, re-enable v3 behind an experiment gated by KV-hit ratio > 95% and seqlen < 1536.
sasha: note: add a small stress test that simulates many concurrent sessions with mixed seqlens to catch KV thrash patterns.
maria: tagging infra/oncall for visibility. @ryan and @kevin please coordinate on the rollout plan. :eyes:
